Access.php.delete: Uses default ObjectModel::delete(). No specific business logic.
Access.php.add: Uses default ObjectModel::add(). No specific business logic.
Access.php.update: Uses default ObjectModel::update(). No specific business logic.

Address.php.delete:
Complex delete logic:
1. Resets customer address cache if linked to a customer.
2. Unlinks from non-ordered carts.
3. If address is used in any Order → softDelete() (keeps data for order history).
4. If not used → hard parent::delete().
Important for webservice: Deleting an address used in orders only marks it as deleted.
Address.php.add: parent::add() + resets customer address cache + updates internal $addressExists cache.
Address.php.update: Clears country/zone caches + updates address cache + if address is used in order, temporarily removes required field validation.

Alias.php.add: Normalizes alias/search (removes accents) + parent::add() + enables PS_ALIAS_FEATURE_ACTIVE.

Attachment.php.delete: Deletes physical file + removes product_attachment links + updates product attachment cache.
Attachment.php.add: Sets file_size from physical file before parent::add().

AttributeGroup.php.delete: Deletes linked attributes + cleans product combinations + cleans positions. Executes hooks.
AttributeGroup.php.add: Sets is_color_group + auto position + parent::add() + hook actionAttributeGroupSave.

Carrier.php.delete: If used in orders → softDelete(). Else hard delete + cleans positions, module links, tax rules.
Carrier.php.add: Auto position + parent::add() + sets default carrier if first + creates id_reference + links to all payment modules.

Cart.php.delete: Prevents deletion if linked to an Order. Cleans customized files, customizations, cart rules and products.
Cart.php.add: Sets default lang/shop if missing + parent::add() + actionCartSave hook.
Cart.php.update: Clears product/weight cache + parent::update() + actionCartSave hook.

CartRule.php.delete: parent::delete() + disables feature flag if no more rules + cleans all associations (cart, carrier, shop, group, country, combinations, etc.).
CartRule.php.add: Sets default reduction_currency + parent::add() + enables feature flag.
CartRule.php.update: Clears cache + sets default currency + parent::update() + updates feature flag.

Category.php.delete: Prevents root category deletion. Deletes all children + cleans associations, images, groups, cart rules + regenerates nested tree (ntree).
Category.php.add: Calculates level_depth + sets root if needed + parent::add() + adds positions in all shops + regenerates ntree + updates groups.
Category.php.update: Prevents self-parent + updates level_depth/positions + regenerates ntree if parent changed.

CMS.php.delete: parent::delete() + cleans positions in its category.

CMSCategory.php.delete: Prevents deletion of ID 1. Deletes children recursively + cleans positions.
CMSCategory.php.add: Sets position + level_depth + parent::add() + cleans positions.

Combination.php.delete: Removes stock, specific prices, cart links, supplier/pack links + updates default attribute + clears color cache.
Combination.php.add: Handles default_on + creates stock_available entry + applies specific price rules + updates default attribute.

Currency.php.delete: Prevents deletion of default currency. Updates default if needed + softDelete() + removes module restrictions.

Customer.php.delete: Cleans addresses (if no orders), groups, messages, specific prices, carts (without orders), threads, cart rules.
Customer.php.add: Sets shop/lang defaults, secure_key, birthday, default group, newsletter date + parent::add() + updates groups.

Group.php.delete: Prevents deletion of default customer group. Cleans many associations + reassigns customers to default group.
Group.php.add: Enables group feature + assigns to home category + all carriers.

Image.php.delete: parent::delete() + deletes physical images/thumbnails + updates positions.

Language.php.delete: Very heavy: deletes all _lang entries, tags, search words, mail/theme/module translation files, images.
Language.php.add: parent::add() + generates RTL stylesheets if needed + loads update SQL.

Manufacturer.php.delete: Deletes linked address + parent::delete() + cleans cart rules + deletes image.

Product.php.delete: Heavy safety checks (stock, supply orders). Deletes attributes, images, categories, features, tags, carts, attachments, etc. Executes actionProductDelete hook.
Product.php.add: Sets product_type for virtual + stock management + group reduction + unit ratio + hook.

ProductAttribute.php.delete: Deletes combinations + cleans cart rules + positions.

Supplier.php.delete: Deletes address + image + cleans cart rules.

Tab.php.add: Sets position + creates access + clears cache.
Tab.php.update: Adjusts position if parent changes + clears cache.

Zone.php.delete: Cleans carrier_zone, delivery + resets country/state zones.
